original_prompt:
make a top down game 
GAMELOOP:
player has to evade enemy bullets and survive for as long as player can 

player has 3 health 
each enemy spawn at random places 
enemies have different types (enemies can chase player, shoot bullets )
the enemy spawned will have its type(chaser , or bullet shooting ) at random

quests.text: Speak with the Survival Guide to learn the rules of the arena.
Survive and defeat the aggressive chaser enemy.
Evade incoming bullets and defeat the shooter enemy.
Collect the Survival Emblem dropped after proving your endurance.
Use the Survival Emblem to unlock the sanctuary door.

explanation: The designer inserted survival_relic / Survival Emblem as an inventory item despite the absence of any inventory or collection request; required item ID is absent. This was an unsolicited objective artifact, not an enemy projectile.
